name: Goldendoodle
intro: Friendly, intelligent doodles known for teddy-bear looks, family-focused temperaments, and beautiful low-shedding coat possibilities.
idealFamilyFit: Often a good fit for families wanting an affectionate, trainable companion with a playful but people-focused personality.
expectedSizeRange: Micro, petite mini, and mini sizes are planned by pairing and can vary by litter.
temperament: Social, bright, eager to engage, and typically quick to bond with their people.
coatExpectations: Coats may be wavy, straight, or curly depending on pairing and genetics.
sheddingAllergyNotes: No dog is fully hypoallergenic. F1b and multigen pairings are often better for families prioritizing lower shedding.

name: Cavapoo
intro: Sweet, people-loving companion puppies with Cavalier warmth and Poodle intelligence.
idealFamilyFit: Often a good fit for families wanting a smaller companion with a cuddly, adaptable personality.
expectedSizeRange: Micro, petite mini, and mini ranges may be available depending on pairing.
temperament: Affectionate, gentle, playful, and usually very connected to their family.
coatExpectations: Coats can range from silky waves to curlier doodle coats depending on the parents.
sheddingAllergyNotes: Shedding can vary. Pairing notes and parent genetics help guide expectations.

name: Bernedoodle
intro: Loyal, affectionate doodles with Bernese sweetness and Poodle intelligence.
idealFamilyFit: Often a good fit for families wanting a calm, connected dog with a steady temperament.
expectedSizeRange: Micro and mini ranges are planned by pairing and individual litter genetics.
coatExpectations: Coats may be wavy or curly, with tricolor, merle, chocolate, and parti possibilities by pairing.
sheddingAllergyNotes: Lower-shedding traits are planned through genetics, but individual results can vary.
